layman_headline: Holding steady while the market recovers from fear — no new bets yet.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is still in a fearful mood, though sentiment is improving from last week's deeper fear levels. Our two current positions — Solana and Chainlink — are both near their entry prices, with SOL slightly up and LINK slightly down. The best new candidate (Filecoin) looks oversold but is in a brutal long-term downtrend at 99.7% off its all-time high, which makes catching the falling knife too risky right now. Bitcoin dominance remains high at 56.6%, which means altcoins are still under pressure.
layman_action: Keep holding your current SOL and LINK positions. Both are within their trading ranges and haven't hit stop-losses or profit targets. Wait for a clearer setup before adding a third position.
expert_reasoning: FIL is the most technically interesting candidate with RSI at 30 and a -9.9% weekly pullback, but it's down 99.7% from ATH indicating structural decay — catching this knife has poor risk/reward. MON (RSI 39) lacks sufficient data (no MACD, SMA, or volume metrics) and is 56.5% off ATH with flat price action. VVV and VELVET are extended after 22.6% and 7.6% weekly runs respectively. LINK already in portfolio at 11.1% weekly gain. The swing candidate pool is weak — stablecoins (FDUSD, USDG, XAUT) offer no trade, and remaining candidates lack technical confirmation. High BTC dominance at 56.6% continues to suppress altcoin setups. Better to hold existing positions and wait for a higher-conviction entry.
